title: Seoul mayor calls for responsible pet ownership
caption:
As pet ownership surges across Seoul, the city is racing to build more shelter capacity to keep up with abandoned animals. Officials at Yeouido Hangang Park emphasized that modern dog parks and loosened rules mean nothing without lifelong owner commitment.
